title: ERD Studio domain
description: A subject area diagram: .erd-studio/{layer}/{name}.json. References tables by name and holds relationships and canvas layout. Written in the project's naming: schema v6 ("subjectArea", "logical.tables", "fromTable" / "toTable") or v5 ("domain", "logical.models", "fromModel" / "toModel"); `erd-studio doctor` reports which. Reference: https://github.com/liam-machine/erd-studio/blob/main/docs/semantic-domain-json-reference.md#domain-file-erd-studiolayerdomainjson

$schema.description: Optional schema reference for editors outside VS Code. Ignored by ERD Studio.

schemaVersion.description: File format version. 6 for the table naming ("subjectArea", "logical.tables"), 5 for the model naming ("domain", "logical.models"): write the one `erd-studio doctor` reports. Version 4 (inline model objects) still loads until migrated with "ERD Studio: Migrate Subject Areas to the Central Table Library".

domain.description: Schema v5 and v4: the subject area slug. Should equal the file name without .json. Schema v6 calls it "subjectArea".

subjectArea.description: Schema v6: the subject area slug. Should equal the file name without .json.

layer.description: Must match an id in layers.json and the parent directory name.

modelFolder.description: Path prefix filter for the "Add Existing Model" dialog, e.g. models/silver.

stubColumns.description: Models (typically conformed dimensions / reference tables) that define only key columns. Missing-column discrepancies for them are hidden in Compare.

models.description: Schema v5 and v4: table NAME strings. Each resolves to .erd-studio/logical-models/{name}.yml or .erd-studio/logical-models/{folder}/{name}.yml. Never mix names with inline model objects — such a file does not open. Schema v6 calls it "tables".

items.description: Deprecated version 4 inline model. Run "ERD Studio: Migrate Domains to Central Model Store".

tables.description: Schema v6: table NAME strings. Each resolves to .erd-studio/tables/{name}.yml or .erd-studio/tables/{folder}/{name}.yml.

relationships.description: FK relationships. (from, fromColumn, to, toColumn) must be unique within the subject area.

viewConfig.description: Deprecated location — viewConfig belongs at the root of the document.
Canvas layout, at the root of the document. Write {} for a new domain — models without a position are placed automatically.

fromModel.description: Schema v5: the table holding the FK (the "many" side of many-to-one). Schema v6 calls it "fromTable".

fromTable.description: Schema v6: the table holding the FK (the "many" side of many-to-one).

toModel.description: Referenced model (PK side). Schema v6 calls it "toTable".

toTable.description: Schema v6: the referenced table (the "one" side).

cardinality.description: Relationship cardinality, read from fromModel to toModel.

role.description: Optional label for what this link means, e.g. "order date" and "ship date" for two columns pointing at the same date dimension. A label only; it is not part of the relationship's identity.

compositeKey.description: Entries of this file with the same fromModel that share this value form one composite foreign key: one relationship over several column pairs, drawn as one line. Each entry is one column pair; all must point at the same toModel with the same cardinality (many-to-one or one-to-one). ERD Studio 1.6.7 and earlier read the entries as separate relationships and drop this key when they save the file.

viewConfig.description: Canvas layout. Safe to leave as {} — models without a position are placed automatically.

layoutOptions.description: ELK layout options as string key/value pairs, e.g. "elk.direction": "DOWN".

positions.description: Node positions keyed by model name. Preserve existing entries when adding models.

linkedModel.description: Schema v5: draws a dashed edge from the note to this table. Schema v6 calls it "linkedTable".

linkedTable.description: Schema v6: draws a dashed edge from the note to this table.
